The German Workers' Party ( German : Deutsche Arbeiterpartei , DAP ) was an obscure far-right political party established in the Weimar Republic after World War I . It lasted from 5 January 1919 until 24 February 1920. The DAP was the precursor of the National Socialist German Workers' Party (German: Nationalsozialistische Deutsche Arbeiterpartei , NSDAP), commonly known as the Nazi Party.
